notes: DRAFT. Rome likes order; the town is frightened. Pleases the prefect.

name: Hear petitions in the forum
notes: DRAFT. A day of judgement and favours. Pleases the treasurer, who hears what people owe.

name: Dismiss 50 soldiers
notes: DRAFT. Saves pay; Rome likes a strong garrison.

name: Build or plant

name: Lay the keel of a ship
notes: DRAFT. Ready in two seasons. Needs a free berth.

name: Send a trade convoy
notes: DRAFT. One ship to one town; sell and buy there. Back next season (Aquileia: in two).

name: Hold a festival
notes: DRAFT. Games and a feast. Half the effect if held two seasons running.

name: Sacrifice at the temple
notes: DRAFT. The governor sacrifices in public. Pleases the haruspex.

name: Decree honouring Tiberius
notes: DRAFT. An inscription in the forum to the Emperor.

notes: DRAFT. On top of the regular tribute.

name: Listen to the sages
